OrcaBoolScalar.description: Represents a C++ bool serialized as binary string or boolean string.

OrcaBool.description: A C++ bool. Multi-extruder printers serialize this as one value per extruder, so a bare scalar or an array of scalars are both valid.

OrcaIntScalar.description: Represents a C++ integer serialized as a string.

OrcaInt.description: A C++ integer. Multi-extruder printers serialize this as one value per extruder, so a bare scalar or an array of scalars are both valid.

OrcaFloatScalar.description: Represents a C++ double/float serialized as a string.

OrcaFloat.description: A C++ double/float. Multi-extruder printers serialize this as one value per extruder, so a bare scalar or an array of scalars are both valid.

OrcaPercentScalar.description: A percentage value used for dynamic scalar calculations.

OrcaPercent.description: A percentage value. Multi-extruder printers serialize this as one value per extruder, so a bare scalar or an array of scalars are both valid.

OrcaFloatOrPercent.description: A polymorphic type accepting either a static float or a relative percentage.

OrcaExtruderArray.description: Accommodates multi-extruder variables where values can be scalar or per-extruder arrays.

BaseProfileProperties.description: Mandatory identity metadata for all OrcaSlicer presets, governing internal DAG resolution.

setting_id.description: 16-char base62 for cloned/user profiles, but OrcaSlicer's own system bundles also use short legacy codes (e.g. 'GP004') and some codes include underscore/hyphen (e.g. 'GFSG96_00', 'BFLSBS99-1'), so the pattern only checks charset, not length.
